points.name: 已经/还没, 因为...所以..., 虽然...但是...
points.explain: 已经 ("already") and 还没 ("not yet") mark whether something has happened. 因为...所以... links a reason to its result ("because...so..."). 虽然...但是... links a concession to a contrast ("although...but...").

sentences.en: He has already gone to school.

transform.en: He has not gone to school yet.

sentences.zh: 因为天气冷所以我不想去
sentences.en: Because the weather is cold, I don't want to go.

sentences.zh: 虽然天气热但是我想去
sentences.en: Although the weather is hot, I want to go.
